name: Rentstart Bond Loan
summary: Interest-free loan covering up to 100% of a rental bond for low-income NSW renters with limited savings.
key: The interest-free loan can be up to 100% of your rental bond.
who: Australian citizen or permanent resident in NSW
Rent no more than 50% of household gross weekly income
how: Apply online or with the PDF form
catches: The Homes NSW factsheet gives the rent limit as 60% of income; check with Homes NSW.

source.label: Service NSW: Apply for a Rentstart Bond Loan

evidence.quote: The interest-free loan can be up to 100% of your rental bond.
have less than $5,000 in cash assets
